message: Vector Rebel v2.3.10 beta is current.
releaseNotes: Final Item Log verification fix. The parser now reconstructs real history rows across semantic tables, ARIA grids, and sibling-cell layouts using deterministic row text with separators; preserves duplicate same-day rows; supports smart apostrophes; detects table layouts without semantic headers; and retains conservative baseline + exactly-one-new-COMPLETE-row confirmation.
